topic.title: Transfer of history compression gains to the current strongest representation
topic.question: Under the frozen inputs and training protocol, does combining the committed g2 diversity-factorized history approach with the newer g0 pair-joint representation exceed both frozen source bests, especially validation four-task macro ROC-AUC 0.8314095190610717, at justified parameter and measured compute cost?
topic.hypothesis: The g2 improvement over relation-content counts may preserve information still useful to the newer g0 representation, but their shared ancestry may already capture it or cause interference. Inherit only the committed source approaches, subject to implementation inspection in the next phase. Improvement over both frozen bests under source-replacement/factorial and matched-capacity controls, followed by repetition, would support added predictive utility. Failure to exceed the stronger source, gains explained by capacity, or disappearance on repetition would oppose that explanation. No mechanism or novelty is established by the compact summaries; use validation for selection and freeze before withheld assessment.
